subject: Garuda
text: Defeating Garuda awards 221 EXP and 266 GP.

evidence.quote:
EXP gained:         221
GP:                 266

subject: Garuda
text: The Flame Flail is recommended against Garuda because it can land more attacks than other weapon types and destroys his Feather Blades.

evidence.quote:
I suggest you use the Flame Flail as it can attack more times than the other 
weapon types...Your Flail will destroy all 
Feather Blades that he throws at you.

subject: Garuda
text: To avoid damage from Garuda, stay in the lower left corner when he is upper left, move to the lower right corner when he is upper right, and follow him when he charges.

evidence.quote:
Garuda is VERY EASY! Just stay on the lower left corner if he is 
on the upper left, and go to the lower right corner if he is on the upper 
right. Just attack and attack while you’re in the corner. Once he charges, 
just follow him. You’ll receive no damage at all.

subject: Marcie
text: Before proceeding after Garuda, you can cast Cure until HP is full and ask Marcie to restore all MP.

evidence.quote:
In the next screen, you can 
take advantage of Marcie for the last time. Equip your Cure magic and then use 
it until your HP is at full. Then, ASK Marcie to restore all MPs!

subject: Samurai Armor
text: If your item inventory is full and you repeatedly examine a chest dropped by a Ninja, you will receive the Samurai Armor.

evidence.quote:
You can get Elixirs from the Ninja’s right? Now, if your item inventory is 
full and you examine a chest left by a ninja, it will say “Can’t Carry” right? 
Now, here's something great. Keep on examining it and you’ll get the most 
powerful Armor in the game, the Samurai Armor.

subject: Samurai Helmet
text: Repeatedly examining a chest dropped by a Devil Head with a full inventory yields the Samurai Helmet.

evidence.quote:
The Devil Heads here that can only be destroyed by using the Nuke Magic, give 
off X-Ethers. If you do the same thing as you did to the Ninja, you’ll be able 
to get the most powerful Helmet in the game, the Samurai Helmet.

subject: Aegis Shield
text: Repeatedly examining a chest dropped by an Elephant near the final boss with a full inventory yields the Aegis Shield, which deflects all projectile attacks.

evidence.quote:
The Elephants near the last boss will give you a Unicorn. If you do the same 
thing as you did with the Ninjas and the Devil Heads, you’ll get the most 
powerful shield in the game, the Aegis Shield. It can deflect ANY projectile 
attack at you. Even the strong force balls of the last boss.

subject: Dragon
text: Defeating the Dragon awards 0 EXP and 257 GP.

evidence.quote:
EXP gained:         0
GP:                 257

subject: Dragon
text: Use the Flame Flail or Thunder Spear to attack only the Dragon's head, as other body parts cannot be damaged.

evidence.quote:
Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail or Thunder Spear...Just use your Flail or Spear to attack the Head 
ONLY. You can’t damage any other part of its body.

subject: Temple of Mana
text: Cast Ice Magic to turn the monster at the bottom of the screen into a snowman to open the right door.

evidence.quote:
Now, in this room, there’s a 
trapped monster in the bottom of the screen. Now, equip your Ice Magic and use 
to turn the monster into a snowman...If you successfully turned the monster into a snowman, 
the right door will open.

subject: Red Dragon
text: Defeating the Red Dragon awards 0 EXP and 257 GP.

subject: Red Dragon
text: Attack only the Red Dragon's head using the Flame Flail or Thunder Spear.

evidence.quote:
Preferred Weapon:   Flame Flail or Thunder Spear...Just use your Flail or Spear to 
attack the Head ONLY. You also can’t damage any other part of its body.

subject: Temple of Mana
text: Turn a Ninja into a snowman and place it on the floor switch that is second from the bottom in the left column to open the north door.

evidence.quote:
Here, you’ll see a lot of floor switches formed in a rectangle. You have to change a Ninja into a snowman and put it in the correct 
Floor Switch. In the left COLUMN of switches, the correct one is the ones 
which is second from below. Put the snowman there and the door to the north 
will open.

subject: Dragon Zombie
text: Defeating the Dragon Zombie awards 0 EXP and 270 GP.

subject: Dragon Zombie
text: Attack the Dragon Zombie's head with a flail or spear while avoiding contact and fireballs, which deal heavy damage.

evidence.quote:
All you have to do is to attack the head with your flail or 
spear. Beware though, if his fireballs hit you or you accidentally touched it, 
it will deal a big amount of damage compared to the previous 2 dragons.

subject: Excalibur
text: Fuji's mother bestows Excalibur, the most powerful weapon in the game.

evidence.quote:
Now, on the way, you’ll see 
Fuji’s Mom. She’ll tell you that you have been a great Gemma knight. She will 
now bestow you with the most powerful weapon in the game, the Excalibur!

subject: Temple of Mana
text: Level 50 or higher is recommended before ascending the ladder to fight Julius, and you can grind on the elephants to reach level 50.

evidence.quote:
When you reach the area where 
you can see 2 big trees to the left and right and a big ladder in the middle, 
prepare your character for the final battle! I recommend level 50+ when you’re 
here. You can level up your character by beating the elephants here until you 
reach level 50.

subject: Julius
text: The charging attack of the maxed Excalibur Sword is the most efficient attack against all three forms of Julius.

evidence.quote:
Note: You should use the Excalibur Sword...And, in all three forms of Julius, the charging 
attack of the MAXed sword is the most efficient attack to use.

subject: Julius (First Form)
text: Defeating the first form of Julius awards 638 EXP and 818 GP.

evidence.quote:
FIRST FORM:
-----------
Attacks:  Sword
EXP:      638
GP:       818

subject: Julius (First Form)
text: Julius appears as triplets in his first form, and you must attack and defeat all three until they disappear.

evidence.quote:
Julius will be in triplets. You just have to attack and beat all three until 
all of them disappears.

subject: Julius (Second Form)
text: Defeating the second form of Julius awards 0 EXP and 162 GP.

evidence.quote:
SECOND FORM:
------------
Attacks:  Lightning Bolts, Charging Attack
EXP:      0
GP:       162

subject: Julius (Second Form)
text: In his second form, Julius flies above throwing lightning bolts and charges downwards or horizontally, so try to stay by his side.

evidence.quote:
He’ll be flying on top while throwing Lightning bolts. From time to time, he 
will also charge downwards so try to be always by his side. He can charge from 
left to right or vice versa though.

subject: Julius (Third Form)
text: Equipping the Aegis Shield negates Julius's force balls in his third form, while Fuji can be asked to regenerate HP and Nuke can be used alongside Excalibur.

evidence.quote:
With 
you Aegis Shield, the force balls are NOTHING! He will be hard to beat, but 
with Fuji as your companion, you can ASK her to regenerate your HP while 
fighting. What I did was I also equipped the Nuke at the same time, attacking 
with the Excalibur.
